        name = parts[1]

        owner_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)
        name_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)

        # Single line for compact names, two lines for long ones
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 11), owner, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=owner_f)
        name_color = TEXT_PRIMARY if rank > 1 else (220, 255, 220)
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 30), name, fill=name_color, font=name_f)

        # Star bar
        bar_x = table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 4
        bar_max_w = stars_w - 12
        bar_w = max(8, int(bar_max_w * stars / max_stars))
        bar_h_inner = 26
        bar_y = ry + (row_h - bar_h_inner) // 2

        # Bar color based on tier
        if stars >= 5000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.35)
        elif stars >= 3000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.25)
        elif stars >= 2000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, row_bg, 0.25)
        else:
            bar_fill = blend_color(TEXT_SECONDARY, row_bg, 0.18)

        draw.rounded_rectangle((bar_x, bar_y, bar_x + bar_w, bar_y + bar_h_inner),
                               radius=3, fill=bar_fill)

        # Star count text on top of bar
        stars_str = f"+{stars:,}"
        sf = font(MONO_BOLD, 19)
        if stars >= 3000:
            star_color = GREEN
        elif stars >= 2000:
            star_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
        else:
            star_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((bar_x + 6, ry + 19), stars_str, fill=star_color, font=sf)

        # Category tag
        cat_bg, cat_fg, cat_label = CAT_STYLES[cat]
        tag_x = table_x + table_w - tag_w + 4
        draw_tag(draw, tag_x, ry + 21, cat_label, cat_bg, cat_fg)

    y += len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 20

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # TREND CLUSTERS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    section_label = "TRENDING CATEGORIES"
    slb = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), section_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=slb)
    y += 26

    clusters = [
        ("Agent Frameworks", "6 repos", "21,865 \u2605", CAT_AGENT_FG,
         "hermes-agent, caveman, mempalace, superpowers, multica, agent-skills"),
        ("Claude Code Ecosystem", "5 repos", "8,510 \u2605", CAT_CLAUDE_FG,
         "claude-code-best-practice, everything-claude-code, claude-mem, claw-code, openclaw"),
        ("AI Utilities & Infra", "5 repos", "11,597 \u2605", CAT_UTILITY_FG,
         "andrej-karpathy-skills, markitdown, career-ops, Kronos, VoxCPM"),
        ("AI Design Tools", "2 repos", "6,009 \u2605", CAT_DESIGN_FG,
         "awesome-design-md, graphify"),
    ]

    cluster_h = 68
    for title_text, count, star_total, accent, repos in clusters:
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + cluster_h), 8, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER)
        draw.rectangle((MARGIN, y+4, MARGIN + 4, y + cluster_h - 4), fill=accent)

        cf1 = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)
        cf2 = font(MONO_BOLD, 14)
        cf3 = font(INTER_REGULAR, 13)

        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 8), title_text, fill=accent, font=cf1)
        # Stats inline
        stat_text = f"{count}  \u2022  {star_total}"
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 30), stat_text, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=cf2)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 48), repos, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=cf3)

        y += cluster_h + 8

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # KEY TAKEAWAYS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    y += 8
    tkw_label = "KEY TAKEAWAYS"
    tkf = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), tkw_label, fill=AMBER, font=tkf)
    y += 28

    takeaways = [
        ("Agent-first development is surging",
         "hermes-agent's ~10K weekly stars dwarf every other entry", GREEN),
        ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast",
         "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", PURPLE),
        ("Infrastructure tools show staying power",
         "markitdown's steady climb reflects sustained community interest", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ]

    ta_title_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    ta_text_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)

    for title_text, desc, color in takeaways:
        draw.ellipse((MARGIN + 4, y + 6, MARGIN + 14, y + 16), fill=color)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y), title_text, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=ta_title_f)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y + 22), desc, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=ta_text_f)
        y += 52

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FOOTER
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    # Gradient fade at bottom
    for gy in range(40):
        alpha = gy / 40.0
        c = blend_color(BG, BG, alpha)
        draw.rectangle((0, H - 60 + gy, W, H - 60 + gy + 1), fill=c)

    footer_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 12)
    footer_text = "Data sourced from star-history.com  \u2022  Week of April 9\u201315, 2026"
    fbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), footer_text, font=footer_f)
    fw = fbox[2] - fbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - fw) // 2, H - 36), footer_text, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=footer_f)

    return img

    img = create_poster()
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode portrait social media poster for the Coding AI Leaderboard."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math

# ── Dimensions (portrait social media, high-res) ──
W, H = 1200, 2400
MARGIN = 48
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ── Colors (dark mode: GitHub dark + Bloomberg terminal aesthetic) ──
BG = (13, 17, 23)           # #0D1117 — GitHub dark bg
CARD_BG = (22, 27, 34)      # #161B22
CARD_BG_ALT = (33, 38, 45)  # #21262D
BORDER = (48, 54, 61)       # #30363D
TEXT_PRIMARY = (230, 237, 243)    # #E6EDF3
TEXT_SECONDARY = (139, 148, 158)  # #8B949E
TEXT_DIM = (110, 118, 129)        # #6E7681

ELECTRIC_BLUE = (88, 166, 255)    # #58A6FF
GREEN = (63, 185, 80)             # #3FB950
AMBER = (210, 153, 34)            # #D29922
PURPLE = (188, 140, 255)          # #BC8CFF
RED = (248, 81, 73)               # #F85149
TEAL = (57, 211, 184)             # #39D3B8
GOLD = (255, 208, 0)              # Gold for #1

# Category colors
CAT_AGENT = (36, 38, 100)         # deep blue-purple bg
CAT_AGENT_FG = (139, 148, 255)    # bright blue-purple
CAT_CLAUDE = (20, 55, 35)         # deep green bg
CAT_CLAUDE_FG = (63, 185, 80)     # green
CAT_UTILITY = (55, 42, 10)        # deep amber bg
CAT_UTILITY_FG = (210, 153, 34)   # amber
CAT_DESIGN = (50, 18, 55)         # deep purple bg
CAT_DESIGN_FG = (188, 140, 255)   # purple
CAT_NEW = (55, 22, 22)            # deep red bg
CAT_NEW_FG = (248, 81, 73)        # red

# ── Fonts ──
INTER_BLACK = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Black.otf"
INTER_EXTRABOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-ExtraBold.otf"
INTER_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Bold.otf"
INTER_SEMIBOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-SemiBold.otf"
INTER_MEDIUM = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Medium.otf"
INTER_REGULAR = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Regular.otf"
MONO_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"

def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          9715, "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", 4917, "utility"),
    (3,  "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              4407, "agent"),
    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                3524, "agent"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",         3246, "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                3048, "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                 2763, "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                    2180, "agent"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", 2151, "claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",     1978, "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",               1828, "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                 1788, "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                  1506, "agent"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                  1286, "utility"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",              1285, "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                   1268, "claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                      1266, "utility"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",             1195, "agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk",                         1098, "utility"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                     1012, "new"),
]

TREND_COLORS = {
    "▲": GREEN,
    "▼": RED,
    "—": TEXT_DIM,
    "N": AMBER,
}

CAT_STYLES = {
    "agent":   (CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG, "AGENT"),
    "claude":  (CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG, "CLAUDE"),
    "utility": (CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG, "UTILITY"),
    "design":  (CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG, "DESIGN"),
    "new":     (CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG, "NEW"),
}

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, outline_width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=outline_width)

def draw_stat_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, accent_color):
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x+w, y+h), 12, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)
    draw.rectangle((x+1, y+1, x+w-1, y+5), fill=accent_color)

    vf = font(MONO_BOLD, 40)
    vbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=vf)
    vw = vbox[2] - vbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - vw) // 2, y + 20), value, fill=accent_color, font=vf)

    lf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 14)
    lbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=lf)
    lw = lbox[2] - lbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - lw) // 2, y + 70), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=lf)

def draw_tag(draw, x, y, text, bg_color, fg_color, fsize=11, pad_x=8, pad_y=4):
    tf = font(INTER_BOLD, fsize)
    tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=tf)
    tw = tbox[2] - tbox[0]
    th = tbox[3] - tbox[1]
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x + tw + 2*pad_x, y + th + 2*pad_y), 4, bg_color)
    draw.text((x + pad_x, y + pad_y - 1), text, fill=fg_color, font=tf)
    return tw + 2*pad_x

def blend_color(c1, c2, alpha):
    return tuple(int(a * alpha + b * (1 - alpha)) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

def create_poster():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── Subtle gradient glow at top ──
    for gy in range(120):
        alpha = 1.0 - (gy / 120.0)
        r = int(25 * alpha)
        g = int(35 * alpha)
        b = int(60 * alpha)
        c = (BG[0] + r, BG[1] + g, BG[2] + b)
        draw.rectangle((0, gy, W, gy + 1), fill=c)

    y = 38

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # HEADER SECTION
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    top_label = "WEEKLY GITHUB STAR GROWTH"
    tlf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    tlbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), top_label, font=tlf)
    tlw = tlbox[2] - tlbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - tlw) // 2, y), top_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=tlf)
    y += 30

    title = "CODING AI"
    tf1 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb1 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=tf1)
    tw1 = tb1[2] - tb1[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw1) // 2, y), title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf1)
    y += 72

    title2 = "LEADERBOARD"
    tf2 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title2, font=tf2)
    tw2 = tb2[2] - tb2[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw2) // 2, y), title2, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf2)
    y += 72

    date_str = "APR 9 – 15, 2026"
    df = font(INTER_MEDIUM, 18)
    dbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), date_str, font=df)
    dw = dbox[2] - dbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - dw) // 2, y), date_str, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=df)
    y += 34

    # Decorative gradient line
    line_w = 300
    lx0 = (W - line_w) // 2
    for lx in range(line_w):
        t = lx / line_w
        if t < 0.5:
            a = t * 2
        else:
            a = (1 - t) * 2
        c = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, BG, a * 0.7)
        draw.rectangle((lx0 + lx, y, lx0 + lx + 1, y + 2), fill=c)
    y += 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # STAT CALLOUTS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    stats = [
        ("~48K", "TOTAL STARS", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
        ("10", "REPOS 2K+", GREEN),
        ("5", "CLAUDE REPOS", PURPLE),
        ("+9,715", "#1 WEEKLY GAIN", AMBER),
    ]

    card_gap = 10
    card_w = (COL_W - card_gap * 3) // 4
    card_h = 96

    for i, (val, lab, col) in enumerate(stats):
        cx = MARGIN + i * (card_w + card_gap)
        draw_stat_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lab, col)

    y += card_h + 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # NARRATIVE HIGHLIGHT BAR
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    highlight_text = "hermes-agent leads with +9,715 stars — nearly 2\u00d7 the runner-up"
    bar_h_hl = 42
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + bar_h_hl), 8,
                      (18, 32, 16), outline=(40, 70, 35))
    hf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    star_prefix = "\u2605  "
    spf = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    spbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), star_prefix, font=spf)
    spw = spbox[2] - spbox[0]
    hbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), highlight_text, font=hf)
    hw = hbox[2] - hbox[0]
    sx = (W - (spw + hw)) // 2
    draw.text((sx, y + 12), star_prefix, fill=GREEN, font=spf)
    draw.text((sx + spw, y + 12), highlight_text, fill=GREEN, font=hf)
    y += bar_h_hl + 16

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # CATEGORY LEGEND
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    legend_items = [
        ("AGENT", CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG),
        ("CLAUDE", CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG),
        ("UTILITY", CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG),
        ("DESIGN", CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG),
        ("NEW", CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG),
    ]

    ltf = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    tag_widths = []
    for label, _, _ in legend_items:
        tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=ltf)
        tag_widths.append(tbox[2] - tbox[0] + 18)
    total_legend_w = sum(tag_widths) + 12 * (len(legend_items) - 1)
    lx = (W - total_legend_w) // 2

    for label, bg, fg in legend_items:
        tw = draw_tag(draw, lx, y, label, bg, fg, fsize=12)
        lx += tw + 12

    y += 32

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FULL TOP 20 RANKING TABLE
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    table_x = MARGIN
    table_w = COL_W
    row_h = 60
    header_h = 36

    rank_w = 52
    trend_w = 34
    stars_w = 165
    tag_w = 78
    repo_w = table_w - rank_w - trend_w - stars_w - tag_w

    table_total_h = header_h + len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 6
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x - 2, y - 2, table_x + table_w + 2, y + table_total_h + 2),
                      10, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)

    # Header
    draw.rounded_rectangle((table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h),
                           radius=0, fill=CARD_BG_ALT)

    hf_sm = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    draw.text((table_x + 18, y + 11), "#", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + 10, y + 11), "REPOSITORY", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 10, y + 11), "WEEKLY \u2605", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + table_w - tag_w + 6, y + 11), "TYPE", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)

    y += header_h + 3
    max_stars = 9715

    for i, (rank, trend, repo, stars, cat) in enumerate(RANKINGS):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Row background
        if rank == 1:
            row_bg = (22, 34, 18)
        elif i % 2 == 0:
            row_bg = CARD_BG
        else:
            row_bg = (17, 21, 28)

        draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + table_w, ry + row_h), fill=row_bg)

        # Separator line
        if i > 0:
            draw.rectangle((table_x + 14, ry, table_x + table_w - 14, ry + 1),
                          fill=(28, 33, 40))

        # #1 row special treatment
        if rank == 1:
            draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + 4, ry + row_h), fill=GREEN)
            # Subtle glow gradient from left
            for gx in range(80):
                alpha = 0.12 * (1 - gx / 80)
                c = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, alpha)
                draw.rectangle((table_x + 4 + gx, ry, table_x + 5 + gx, ry + row_h), fill=c)

        cx = table_x

        # Rank
        rank_f = font(MONO_BOLD, 22)
        rank_str = str(rank)
        rbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), rank_str, font=rank_f)
        rw = rbox[2] - rbox[0]
        if rank == 1:
            rank_color = GOLD
        elif rank <= 3:
            rank_color = AMBER
        else:
            rank_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((cx + (rank_w - rw) // 2, ry + 18), rank_str,
                 fill=rank_color, font=rank_f)
        cx += rank_w

        # Trend
        trend_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 18)
        trend_color = TREND_COLORS.get(trend, TEXT_DIM)
        draw.text((cx + 7, ry + 19), trend, fill=trend_color, font=trend_f)
        cx += trend_w

        # Repo name
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0] + "/"
        name = parts[1]

        owner_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)
        name_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)

        # Single line for compact names, two lines for long ones
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 11), owner, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=owner_f)
        name_color = TEXT_PRIMARY if rank > 1 else (220, 255, 220)
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 30), name, fill=name_color, font=name_f)

        # Star bar
        bar_x = table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 4
        bar_max_w = stars_w - 12
        bar_w = max(8, int(bar_max_w * stars / max_stars))
        bar_h_inner = 26
        bar_y = ry + (row_h - bar_h_inner) // 2

        # Bar color based on tier
        if stars >= 5000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.35)
        elif stars >= 3000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.25)
        elif stars >= 2000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, row_bg, 0.25)
        else:
            bar_fill = blend_color(TEXT_SECONDARY, row_bg, 0.18)

        draw.rounded_rectangle((bar_x, bar_y, bar_x + bar_w, bar_y + bar_h_inner),
                               radius=3, fill=bar_fill)

        # Star count text on top of bar
        stars_str = f"+{stars:,}"
        sf = font(MONO_BOLD, 19)
        if stars >= 3000:
            star_color = GREEN
        elif stars >= 2000:
            star_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
        else:
            star_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((bar_x + 6, ry + 19), stars_str, fill=star_color, font=sf)

        # Category tag
        cat_bg, cat_fg, cat_label = CAT_STYLES[cat]
        tag_x = table_x + table_w - tag_w + 4
        draw_tag(draw, tag_x, ry + 21, cat_label, cat_bg, cat_fg)

    y += len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 20

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # TREND CLUSTERS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    section_label = "TRENDING CATEGORIES"
    slb = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), section_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=slb)
    y += 26

    clusters = [
        ("Agent Frameworks", "6 repos", "21,865 \u2605", CAT_AGENT_FG,
         "hermes-agent, caveman, mempalace, superpowers, multica, agent-skills"),
        ("Claude Code Ecosystem", "5 repos", "8,510 \u2605", CAT_CLAUDE_FG,
         "claude-code-best-practice, everything-claude-code, claude-mem, claw-code, openclaw"),
        ("AI Utilities & Infra", "5 repos", "11,597 \u2605", CAT_UTILITY_FG,
         "andrej-karpathy-skills, markitdown, career-ops, Kronos, VoxCPM"),
        ("AI Design Tools", "2 repos", "6,009 \u2605", CAT_DESIGN_FG,
         "awesome-design-md, graphify"),
    ]

    cluster_h = 68
    for title_text, count, star_total, accent, repos in clusters:
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + cluster_h), 8, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER)
        draw.rectangle((MARGIN, y+4, MARGIN + 4, y + cluster_h - 4), fill=accent)

        cf1 = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)
        cf2 = font(MONO_BOLD, 14)
        cf3 = font(INTER_REGULAR, 13)

        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 8), title_text, fill=accent, font=cf1)
        # Stats inline
        stat_text = f"{count}  \u2022  {star_total}"
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 30), stat_text, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=cf2)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 48), repos, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=cf3)

        y += cluster_h + 8

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # KEY TAKEAWAYS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    y += 8
    tkw_label = "KEY TAKEAWAYS"
    tkf = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), tkw_label, fill=AMBER, font=tkf)
    y += 28

    takeaways = [
        ("Agent-first development is surging",
         "hermes-agent's ~10K weekly stars dwarf every other entry", GREEN),
        ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast",
         "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", PURPLE),
        ("Infrastructure tools show staying power",
         "markitdown's steady climb reflects sustained community interest", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ]

    ta_title_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    ta_text_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)

    for title_text, desc, color in takeaways:
        draw.ellipse((MARGIN + 4, y + 6, MARGIN + 14, y + 16), fill=color)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y), title_text, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=ta_title_f)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y + 22), desc, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=ta_text_f)
        y += 52

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FOOTER
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    # Gradient fade at bottom
    for gy in range(40):
        alpha = gy / 40.0
        c = blend_color(BG, BG, alpha)
        draw.rectangle((0, H - 60 + gy, W, H - 60 + gy + 1), fill=c)

    footer_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 12)
    footer_text = "Data sourced from star-history.com  \u2022  Week of April 9\u201315, 2026"
    fbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), footer_text, font=footer_f)
    fw = fbox[2] - fbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - fw) // 2, H - 36), footer_text, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=footer_f)

    return img


if __name__ == "__main__":
    img = create_poster()
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode portrait social media poster for the Coding AI Leaderboard."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math

# ── Dimensions (portrait social media, high-res) ──
W, H = 1200, 2400
MARGIN = 48
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ── Colors (dark mode: GitHub dark + Bloomberg terminal aesthetic) ──
BG = (13, 17, 23)           # #0D1117 — GitHub dark bg
CARD_BG = (22, 27, 34)      # #161B22
CARD_BG_ALT = (33, 38, 45)  # #21262D
BORDER = (48, 54, 61)       # #30363D
TEXT_PRIMARY = (230, 237, 243)    # #E6EDF3
TEXT_SECONDARY = (139, 148, 158)  # #8B949E
TEXT_DIM = (110, 118, 129)        # #6E7681

ELECTRIC_BLUE = (88, 166, 255)    # #58A6FF
GREEN = (63, 185, 80)             # #3FB950
AMBER = (210, 153, 34)            # #D29922
PURPLE = (188, 140, 255)          # #BC8CFF
RED = (248, 81, 73)               # #F85149
TEAL = (57, 211, 184)             # #39D3B8
GOLD = (255, 208, 0)              # Gold for #1

# Category colors
CAT_AGENT = (36, 38, 100)         # deep blue-purple bg
CAT_AGENT_FG = (139, 148, 255)    # bright blue-purple
CAT_CLAUDE = (20, 55, 35)         # deep green bg
CAT_CLAUDE_FG = (63, 185, 80)     # green
CAT_UTILITY = (55, 42, 10)        # deep amber bg
CAT_UTILITY_FG = (210, 153, 34)   # amber
CAT_DESIGN = (50, 18, 55)         # deep purple bg
CAT_DESIGN_FG = (188, 140, 255)   # purple
CAT_NEW = (55, 22, 22)            # deep red bg
CAT_NEW_FG = (248, 81, 73)        # red

# ── Fonts ──
INTER_BLACK = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Black.otf"
INTER_EXTRABOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-ExtraBold.otf"
INTER_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Bold.otf"
INTER_SEMIBOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-SemiBold.otf"
INTER_MEDIUM = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Medium.otf"
INTER_REGULAR = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Regular.otf"
MONO_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"

def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          9715, "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", 4917, "utility"),
    (3,  "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              4407, "agent"),
    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                3524, "agent"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",         3246, "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                3048, "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                 2763, "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                    2180, "agent"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", 2151, "claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",     1978, "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",               1828, "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                 1788, "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                  1506, "agent"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                  1286, "utility"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",              1285, "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                   1268, "claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                      1266, "utility"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",             1195, "agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk",                         1098, "utility"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                     1012, "new"),
]

TREND_COLORS = {
    "▲": GREEN,
    "▼": RED,
    "—": TEXT_DIM,
    "N": AMBER,
}

CAT_STYLES = {
    "agent":   (CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG, "AGENT"),
    "claude":  (CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG, "CLAUDE"),
    "utility": (CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG, "UTILITY"),
    "design":  (CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG, "DESIGN"),
    "new":     (CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG, "NEW"),
}

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, outline_width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=outline_width)

def draw_stat_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, accent_color):
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x+w, y+h), 12, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)
    draw.rectangle((x+1, y+1, x+w-1, y+5), fill=accent_color)

    vf = font(MONO_BOLD, 40)
    vbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=vf)
    vw = vbox[2] - vbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - vw) // 2, y + 20), value, fill=accent_color, font=vf)

    lf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 14)
    lbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=lf)
    lw = lbox[2] - lbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - lw) // 2, y + 70), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=lf)

def draw_tag(draw, x, y, text, bg_color, fg_color, fsize=11, pad_x=8, pad_y=4):
    tf = font(INTER_BOLD, fsize)
    tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=tf)
    tw = tbox[2] - tbox[0]
    th = tbox[3] - tbox[1]
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x + tw + 2*pad_x, y + th + 2*pad_y), 4, bg_color)
    draw.text((x + pad_x, y + pad_y - 1), text, fill=fg_color, font=tf)
    return tw + 2*pad_x

def blend_color(c1, c2, alpha):
    return tuple(int(a * alpha + b * (1 - alpha)) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

def create_poster():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── Subtle gradient glow at top ──
    for gy in range(120):
        alpha = 1.0 - (gy / 120.0)
        r = int(25 * alpha)
        g = int(35 * alpha)
        b = int(60 * alpha)
        c = (BG[0] + r, BG[1] + g, BG[2] + b)
        draw.rectangle((0, gy, W, gy + 1), fill=c)

    y = 38

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # HEADER SECTION
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    top_label = "WEEKLY GITHUB STAR GROWTH"
    tlf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    tlbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), top_label, font=tlf)
    tlw = tlbox[2] - tlbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - tlw) // 2, y), top_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=tlf)
    y += 30

    title = "CODING AI"
    tf1 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb1 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=tf1)
    tw1 = tb1[2] - tb1[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw1) // 2, y), title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf1)
    y += 72

    title2 = "LEADERBOARD"
    tf2 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title2, font=tf2)
    tw2 = tb2[2] - tb2[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw2) // 2, y), title2, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf2)
    y += 72

    date_str = "APR 9 – 15, 2026"
    df = font(INTER_MEDIUM, 18)
    dbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), date_str, font=df)
    dw = dbox[2] - dbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - dw) // 2, y), date_str, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=df)
    y += 34

    # Decorative gradient line
    line_w = 300
    lx0 = (W - line_w) // 2
    for lx in range(line_w):
        t = lx / line_w
        if t < 0.5:
            a = t * 2
        else:
            a = (1 - t) * 2
        c = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, BG, a * 0.7)
        draw.rectangle((lx0 + lx, y, lx0 + lx + 1, y + 2), fill=c)
    y += 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # STAT CALLOUTS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    stats = [
        ("~48K", "TOTAL STARS", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
        ("10", "REPOS 2K+", GREEN),
        ("5", "CLAUDE REPOS", PURPLE),
        ("+9,715", "#1 WEEKLY GAIN", AMBER),
    ]

    card_gap = 10
    card_w = (COL_W - card_gap * 3) // 4
    card_h = 96

    for i, (val, lab, col) in enumerate(stats):
        cx = MARGIN + i * (card_w + card_gap)
        draw_stat_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lab, col)

    y += card_h + 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # NARRATIVE HIGHLIGHT BAR
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    highlight_text = "hermes-agent leads with +9,715 stars — nearly 2\u00d7 the runner-up"
    bar_h_hl = 42
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + bar_h_hl), 8,
                      (18, 32, 16), outline=(40, 70, 35))
    hf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    star_prefix = "\u2605  "
    spf = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    spbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), star_prefix, font=spf)
    spw = spbox[2] - spbox[0]
    hbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), highlight_text, font=hf)
    hw = hbox[2] - hbox[0]
    sx = (W - (spw + hw)) // 2
    draw.text((sx, y + 12), star_prefix, fill=GREEN, font=spf)
    draw.text((sx + spw, y + 12), highlight_text, fill=GREEN, font=hf)
    y += bar_h_hl + 16

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # CATEGORY LEGEND
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    legend_items = [
        ("AGENT", CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG),
        ("CLAUDE", CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG),
        ("UTILITY", CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG),
        ("DESIGN", CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG),
        ("NEW", CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG),
    ]

    ltf = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    tag_widths = []
    for label, _, _ in legend_items:
        tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=ltf)
        tag_widths.append(tbox[2] - tbox[0] + 18)
    total_legend_w = sum(tag_widths) + 12 * (len(legend_items) - 1)
    lx = (W - total_legend_w) // 2

    for label, bg, fg in legend_items:
        tw = draw_tag(draw, lx, y, label, bg, fg, fsize=12)
        lx += tw + 12

    y += 32

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FULL TOP 20 RANKING TABLE
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    table_x = MARGIN
    table_w = COL_W
    row_h = 60
    header_h = 36

    rank_w = 52
    trend_w = 34
    stars_w = 165
    tag_w = 78
    repo_w = table_w - rank_w - trend_w - stars_w - tag_w

    table_total_h = header_h + len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 6
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x - 2, y - 2, table_x + table_w + 2, y + table_total_h + 2),
                      10, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)

    # Header
    draw.rounded_rectangle((table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h),
                           radius=0, fill=CARD_BG_ALT)

    hf_sm = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    draw.text((table_x + 18, y + 11), "#", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + 10, y + 11), "REPOSITORY", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 10, y + 11), "WEEKLY \u2605", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + table_w - tag_w + 6, y + 11), "TYPE", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)

    y += header_h + 3
    max_stars = 9715

    for i, (rank, trend, repo, stars, cat) in enumerate(RANKINGS):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Row background
        if rank == 1:
            row_bg = (22, 34, 18)
        elif i % 2 == 0:
            row_bg = CARD_BG
        else:
            row_bg = (17, 21, 28)

        draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + table_w, ry + row_h), fill=row_bg)

        # Separator line
        if i > 0:
            draw.rectangle((table_x + 14, ry, table_x + table_w - 14, ry + 1),
                          fill=(28, 33, 40))

        # #1 row special treatment
        if rank == 1:
            draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + 4, ry + row_h), fill=GREEN)
            # Subtle glow gradient from left
            for gx in range(80):
                alpha = 0.12 * (1 - gx / 80)
                c = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, alpha)
                draw.rectangle((table_x + 4 + gx, ry, table_x + 5 + gx, ry + row_h), fill=c)

        cx = table_x

        # Rank
        rank_f = font(MONO_BOLD, 22)
        rank_str = str(rank)
        rbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), rank_str, font=rank_f)
        rw = rbox[2] - rbox[0]
        if rank == 1:
            rank_color = GOLD
        elif rank <= 3:
            rank_color = AMBER
        else:
            rank_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((cx + (rank_w - rw) // 2, ry + 18), rank_str,
                 fill=rank_color, font=rank_f)
        cx += rank_w

        # Trend
        trend_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 18)
        trend_color = TREND_COLORS.get(trend, TEXT_DIM)
        draw.text((cx + 7, ry + 19), trend, fill=trend_color, font=trend_f)
        cx += trend_w

        # Repo name
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0] + "/"
        name = parts[1]

        owner_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)
        name_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)

        # Single line for compact names, two lines for long ones
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 11), owner, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=owner_f)
        name_color = TEXT_PRIMARY if rank > 1 else (220, 255, 220)
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 30), name, fill=name_color, font=name_f)

        # Star bar
        bar_x = table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 4
        bar_max_w = stars_w - 12
        bar_w = max(8, int(bar_max_w * stars / max_stars))
        bar_h_inner = 26
        bar_y = ry + (row_h - bar_h_inner) // 2

        # Bar color based on tier
        if stars >= 5000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.35)
        elif stars >= 3000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.25)
        elif stars >= 2000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, row_bg, 0.25)
        else:
            bar_fill = blend_color(TEXT_SECONDARY, row_bg, 0.18)

        draw.rounded_rectangle((bar_x, bar_y, bar_x + bar_w, bar_y + bar_h_inner),
                               radius=3, fill=bar_fill)

        # Star count text on top of bar
        stars_str = f"+{stars:,}"
        sf = font(MONO_BOLD, 19)
        if stars >= 3000:
            star_color = GREEN
        elif stars >= 2000:
            star_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
        else:
            star_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((bar_x + 6, ry + 19), stars_str, fill=star_color, font=sf)

        # Category tag
        cat_bg, cat_fg, cat_label = CAT_STYLES[cat]
        tag_x = table_x + table_w - tag_w + 4
        draw_tag(draw, tag_x, ry + 21, cat_label, cat_bg, cat_fg)

    y += len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 20

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # TREND CLUSTERS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    section_label = "TRENDING CATEGORIES"
    slb = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), section_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=slb)
    y += 26

    clusters = [
        ("Agent Frameworks", "6 repos", "21,865 \u2605", CAT_AGENT_FG,
         "hermes-agent, caveman, mempalace, superpowers, multica, agent-skills"),
        ("Claude Code Ecosystem", "5 repos", "8,510 \u2605", CAT_CLAUDE_FG,
         "claude-code-best-practice, everything-claude-code, claude-mem, claw-code, openclaw"),
        ("AI Utilities & Infra", "5 repos", "11,597 \u2605", CAT_UTILITY_FG,
         "andrej-karpathy-skills, markitdown, career-ops, Kronos, VoxCPM"),
        ("AI Design Tools", "2 repos", "6,009 \u2605", CAT_DESIGN_FG,
         "awesome-design-md, graphify"),
    ]

    cluster_h = 68
    for title_text, count, star_total, accent, repos in clusters:
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + cluster_h), 8, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER)
        draw.rectangle((MARGIN, y+4, MARGIN + 4, y + cluster_h - 4), fill=accent)

        cf1 = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)
        cf2 = font(MONO_BOLD, 14)
        cf3 = font(INTER_REGULAR, 13)

        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 8), title_text, fill=accent, font=cf1)
        # Stats inline
        stat_text = f"{count}  \u2022  {star_total}"
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 30), stat_text, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=cf2)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 48), repos, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=cf3)

        y += cluster_h + 8

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # KEY TAKEAWAYS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    y += 8
    tkw_label = "KEY TAKEAWAYS"
    tkf = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), tkw_label, fill=AMBER, font=tkf)
    y += 28

    takeaways = [
        ("Agent-first development is surging",
         "hermes-agent's ~10K weekly stars dwarf every other entry", GREEN),
        ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast",
         "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", PURPLE),
        ("Infrastructure tools show staying power",
         "markitdown's steady climb reflects sustained community interest", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ]

    ta_title_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    ta_text_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)

    for title_text, desc, color in takeaways:
        draw.ellipse((MARGIN + 4, y + 6, MARGIN + 14, y + 16), fill=color)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y), title_text, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=ta_title_f)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y + 22), desc, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=ta_text_f)
        y += 52

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FOOTER
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    # Gradient fade at bottom
    for gy in range(40):
        alpha = gy / 40.0
        c = blend_color(BG, BG, alpha)
        draw.rectangle((0, H - 60 + gy, W, H - 60 + gy + 1), fill=c)

    footer_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 12)
    footer_text = "Data sourced from star-history.com  \u2022  Week of April 9\u201315, 2026"
    fbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), footer_text, font=footer_f)
    fw = fbox[2] - fbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - fw) // 2, H - 36), footer_text, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=footer_f)

    return img


if __name__ == "__main__":
    img = create_poster()
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode portrait social media poster for the Coding AI Leaderboard."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math

# ── Dimensions (portrait social media, high-res) ──
W, H = 1200, 2400
MARGIN = 48
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ── Colors (dark mode: GitHub dark + Bloomberg terminal aesthetic) ──
BG = (13, 17, 23)           # #0D1117 — GitHub dark bg
CARD_BG = (22, 27, 34)      # #161B22
CARD_BG_ALT = (33, 38, 45)  # #21262D
BORDER = (48, 54, 61)       # #30363D
TEXT_PRIMARY = (230, 237, 243)    # #E6EDF3
TEXT_SECONDARY = (139, 148, 158)  # #8B949E
TEXT_DIM = (110, 118, 129)        # #6E7681

ELECTRIC_BLUE = (88, 166, 255)    # #58A6FF
GREEN = (63, 185, 80)             # #3FB950
AMBER = (210, 153, 34)            # #D29922
PURPLE = (188, 140, 255)          # #BC8CFF
RED = (248, 81, 73)               # #F85149
TEAL = (57, 211, 184)             # #39D3B8
GOLD = (255, 208, 0)              # Gold for #1

# Category colors
CAT_AGENT = (36, 38, 100)         # deep blue-purple bg
CAT_AGENT_FG = (139, 148, 255)    # bright blue-purple
CAT_CLAUDE = (20, 55, 35)         # deep green bg
CAT_CLAUDE_FG = (63, 185, 80)     # green
CAT_UTILITY = (55, 42, 10)        # deep amber bg
CAT_UTILITY_FG = (210, 153, 34)   # amber
CAT_DESIGN = (50, 18, 55)         # deep purple bg
CAT_DESIGN_FG = (188, 140, 255)   # purple
CAT_NEW = (55, 22, 22)            # deep red bg
CAT_NEW_FG = (248, 81, 73)        # red

# ── Fonts ──
INTER_BLACK = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Black.otf"
INTER_EXTRABOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-ExtraBold.otf"
INTER_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Bold.otf"
INTER_SEMIBOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-SemiBold.otf"
INTER_MEDIUM = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Medium.otf"
INTER_REGULAR = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Regular.otf"
MONO_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf"
MONO = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"

def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# ── Data ──
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent",          9715, "agent"),
    (2,  "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", 4917, "utility"),
    (3,  "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman",              4407, "agent"),
    (4,  "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace",                3524, "agent"),
    (5,  "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",         3246, "design"),
    (6,  "▲", "microsoft/markitdown",                3048, "utility"),
    (7,  "▼", "safishamsi/graphify",                 2763, "design"),
    (8,  "▲", "obra/superpowers",                    2180, "agent"),
    (9,  "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", 2151, "claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",     1978, "claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem",               1828, "claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops",                 1788, "utility"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica",                  1506, "agent"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                  1286, "utility"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code",              1285, "claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw",                   1268, "claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                      1266, "utility"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills",             1195, "agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk",                         1098, "utility"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack",                     1012, "new"),
]

TREND_COLORS = {
    "▲": GREEN,
    "▼": RED,
    "—": TEXT_DIM,
    "N": AMBER,
}

CAT_STYLES = {
    "agent":   (CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG, "AGENT"),
    "claude":  (CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG, "CLAUDE"),
    "utility": (CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG, "UTILITY"),
    "design":  (CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG, "DESIGN"),
    "new":     (CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG, "NEW"),
}

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, outline_width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=outline_width)

def draw_stat_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, accent_color):
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x+w, y+h), 12, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)
    draw.rectangle((x+1, y+1, x+w-1, y+5), fill=accent_color)

    vf = font(MONO_BOLD, 40)
    vbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=vf)
    vw = vbox[2] - vbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - vw) // 2, y + 20), value, fill=accent_color, font=vf)

    lf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 14)
    lbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=lf)
    lw = lbox[2] - lbox[0]
    draw.text((x + (w - lw) // 2, y + 70), label, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=lf)

def draw_tag(draw, x, y, text, bg_color, fg_color, fsize=11, pad_x=8, pad_y=4):
    tf = font(INTER_BOLD, fsize)
    tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=tf)
    tw = tbox[2] - tbox[0]
    th = tbox[3] - tbox[1]
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x + tw + 2*pad_x, y + th + 2*pad_y), 4, bg_color)
    draw.text((x + pad_x, y + pad_y - 1), text, fill=fg_color, font=tf)
    return tw + 2*pad_x

def blend_color(c1, c2, alpha):
    return tuple(int(a * alpha + b * (1 - alpha)) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

def create_poster():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── Subtle gradient glow at top ──
    for gy in range(120):
        alpha = 1.0 - (gy / 120.0)
        r = int(25 * alpha)
        g = int(35 * alpha)
        b = int(60 * alpha)
        c = (BG[0] + r, BG[1] + g, BG[2] + b)
        draw.rectangle((0, gy, W, gy + 1), fill=c)

    y = 38

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # HEADER SECTION
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    top_label = "WEEKLY GITHUB STAR GROWTH"
    tlf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    tlbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), top_label, font=tlf)
    tlw = tlbox[2] - tlbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - tlw) // 2, y), top_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=tlf)
    y += 30

    title = "CODING AI"
    tf1 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb1 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=tf1)
    tw1 = tb1[2] - tb1[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw1) // 2, y), title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf1)
    y += 72

    title2 = "LEADERBOARD"
    tf2 = font(INTER_BLACK, 64)
    tb2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), title2, font=tf2)
    tw2 = tb2[2] - tb2[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw2) // 2, y), title2, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=tf2)
    y += 72

    date_str = "APR 9 – 15, 2026"
    df = font(INTER_MEDIUM, 18)
    dbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), date_str, font=df)
    dw = dbox[2] - dbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - dw) // 2, y), date_str, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=df)
    y += 34

    # Decorative gradient line
    line_w = 300
    lx0 = (W - line_w) // 2
    for lx in range(line_w):
        t = lx / line_w
        if t < 0.5:
            a = t * 2
        else:
            a = (1 - t) * 2
        c = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, BG, a * 0.7)
        draw.rectangle((lx0 + lx, y, lx0 + lx + 1, y + 2), fill=c)
    y += 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # STAT CALLOUTS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    stats = [
        ("~48K", "TOTAL STARS", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
        ("10", "REPOS 2K+", GREEN),
        ("5", "CLAUDE REPOS", PURPLE),
        ("+9,715", "#1 WEEKLY GAIN", AMBER),
    ]

    card_gap = 10
    card_w = (COL_W - card_gap * 3) // 4
    card_h = 96

    for i, (val, lab, col) in enumerate(stats):
        cx = MARGIN + i * (card_w + card_gap)
        draw_stat_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lab, col)

    y += card_h + 18

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # NARRATIVE HIGHLIGHT BAR
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    highlight_text = "hermes-agent leads with +9,715 stars — nearly 2\u00d7 the runner-up"
    bar_h_hl = 42
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + bar_h_hl), 8,
                      (18, 32, 16), outline=(40, 70, 35))
    hf = font(INTER_SEMIBOLD, 15)
    star_prefix = "\u2605  "
    spf = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    spbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), star_prefix, font=spf)
    spw = spbox[2] - spbox[0]
    hbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), highlight_text, font=hf)
    hw = hbox[2] - hbox[0]
    sx = (W - (spw + hw)) // 2
    draw.text((sx, y + 12), star_prefix, fill=GREEN, font=spf)
    draw.text((sx + spw, y + 12), highlight_text, fill=GREEN, font=hf)
    y += bar_h_hl + 16

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # CATEGORY LEGEND
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    legend_items = [
        ("AGENT", CAT_AGENT, CAT_AGENT_FG),
        ("CLAUDE", CAT_CLAUDE, CAT_CLAUDE_FG),
        ("UTILITY", CAT_UTILITY, CAT_UTILITY_FG),
        ("DESIGN", CAT_DESIGN, CAT_DESIGN_FG),
        ("NEW", CAT_NEW, CAT_NEW_FG),
    ]

    ltf = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    tag_widths = []
    for label, _, _ in legend_items:
        tbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=ltf)
        tag_widths.append(tbox[2] - tbox[0] + 18)
    total_legend_w = sum(tag_widths) + 12 * (len(legend_items) - 1)
    lx = (W - total_legend_w) // 2

    for label, bg, fg in legend_items:
        tw = draw_tag(draw, lx, y, label, bg, fg, fsize=12)
        lx += tw + 12

    y += 32

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FULL TOP 20 RANKING TABLE
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    table_x = MARGIN
    table_w = COL_W
    row_h = 60
    header_h = 36

    rank_w = 52
    trend_w = 34
    stars_w = 165
    tag_w = 78
    repo_w = table_w - rank_w - trend_w - stars_w - tag_w

    table_total_h = header_h + len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 6
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (table_x - 2, y - 2, table_x + table_w + 2, y + table_total_h + 2),
                      10, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER, outline_width=1)

    # Header
    draw.rounded_rectangle((table_x, y, table_x + table_w, y + header_h),
                           radius=0, fill=CARD_BG_ALT)

    hf_sm = font(INTER_BOLD, 12)
    draw.text((table_x + 18, y + 11), "#", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + 10, y + 11), "REPOSITORY", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 10, y + 11), "WEEKLY \u2605", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)
    draw.text((table_x + table_w - tag_w + 6, y + 11), "TYPE", fill=TEXT_DIM, font=hf_sm)

    y += header_h + 3
    max_stars = 9715

    for i, (rank, trend, repo, stars, cat) in enumerate(RANKINGS):
        ry = y + i * row_h

        # Row background
        if rank == 1:
            row_bg = (22, 34, 18)
        elif i % 2 == 0:
            row_bg = CARD_BG
        else:
            row_bg = (17, 21, 28)

        draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + table_w, ry + row_h), fill=row_bg)

        # Separator line
        if i > 0:
            draw.rectangle((table_x + 14, ry, table_x + table_w - 14, ry + 1),
                          fill=(28, 33, 40))

        # #1 row special treatment
        if rank == 1:
            draw.rectangle((table_x, ry, table_x + 4, ry + row_h), fill=GREEN)
            # Subtle glow gradient from left
            for gx in range(80):
                alpha = 0.12 * (1 - gx / 80)
                c = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, alpha)
                draw.rectangle((table_x + 4 + gx, ry, table_x + 5 + gx, ry + row_h), fill=c)

        cx = table_x

        # Rank
        rank_f = font(MONO_BOLD, 22)
        rank_str = str(rank)
        rbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), rank_str, font=rank_f)
        rw = rbox[2] - rbox[0]
        if rank == 1:
            rank_color = GOLD
        elif rank <= 3:
            rank_color = AMBER
        else:
            rank_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((cx + (rank_w - rw) // 2, ry + 18), rank_str,
                 fill=rank_color, font=rank_f)
        cx += rank_w

        # Trend
        trend_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 18)
        trend_color = TREND_COLORS.get(trend, TEXT_DIM)
        draw.text((cx + 7, ry + 19), trend, fill=trend_color, font=trend_f)
        cx += trend_w

        # Repo name
        parts = repo.split("/")
        owner = parts[0] + "/"
        name = parts[1]

        owner_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)
        name_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)

        # Single line for compact names, two lines for long ones
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 11), owner, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=owner_f)
        name_color = TEXT_PRIMARY if rank > 1 else (220, 255, 220)
        draw.text((cx + 10, ry + 30), name, fill=name_color, font=name_f)

        # Star bar
        bar_x = table_x + rank_w + trend_w + repo_w + 4
        bar_max_w = stars_w - 12
        bar_w = max(8, int(bar_max_w * stars / max_stars))
        bar_h_inner = 26
        bar_y = ry + (row_h - bar_h_inner) // 2

        # Bar color based on tier
        if stars >= 5000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.35)
        elif stars >= 3000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(GREEN, row_bg, 0.25)
        elif stars >= 2000:
            bar_fill = blend_color(ELECTRIC_BLUE, row_bg, 0.25)
        else:
            bar_fill = blend_color(TEXT_SECONDARY, row_bg, 0.18)

        draw.rounded_rectangle((bar_x, bar_y, bar_x + bar_w, bar_y + bar_h_inner),
                               radius=3, fill=bar_fill)

        # Star count text on top of bar
        stars_str = f"+{stars:,}"
        sf = font(MONO_BOLD, 19)
        if stars >= 3000:
            star_color = GREEN
        elif stars >= 2000:
            star_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
        else:
            star_color = TEXT_SECONDARY
        draw.text((bar_x + 6, ry + 19), stars_str, fill=star_color, font=sf)

        # Category tag
        cat_bg, cat_fg, cat_label = CAT_STYLES[cat]
        tag_x = table_x + table_w - tag_w + 4
        draw_tag(draw, tag_x, ry + 21, cat_label, cat_bg, cat_fg)

    y += len(RANKINGS) * row_h + 20

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # TREND CLUSTERS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    section_label = "TRENDING CATEGORIES"
    slb = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), section_label, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=slb)
    y += 26

    clusters = [
        ("Agent Frameworks", "6 repos", "21,865 \u2605", CAT_AGENT_FG,
         "hermes-agent, caveman, mempalace, superpowers, multica, agent-skills"),
        ("Claude Code Ecosystem", "5 repos", "8,510 \u2605", CAT_CLAUDE_FG,
         "claude-code-best-practice, everything-claude-code, claude-mem, claw-code, openclaw"),
        ("AI Utilities & Infra", "5 repos", "11,597 \u2605", CAT_UTILITY_FG,
         "andrej-karpathy-skills, markitdown, career-ops, Kronos, VoxCPM"),
        ("AI Design Tools", "2 repos", "6,009 \u2605", CAT_DESIGN_FG,
         "awesome-design-md, graphify"),
    ]

    cluster_h = 68
    for title_text, count, star_total, accent, repos in clusters:
        draw_rounded_rect(draw, (MARGIN, y, W - MARGIN, y + cluster_h), 8, CARD_BG, outline=BORDER)
        draw.rectangle((MARGIN, y+4, MARGIN + 4, y + cluster_h - 4), fill=accent)

        cf1 = font(INTER_BOLD, 17)
        cf2 = font(MONO_BOLD, 14)
        cf3 = font(INTER_REGULAR, 13)

        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 8), title_text, fill=accent, font=cf1)
        # Stats inline
        stat_text = f"{count}  \u2022  {star_total}"
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 30), stat_text, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=cf2)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 18, y + 48), repos, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=cf3)

        y += cluster_h + 8

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # KEY TAKEAWAYS
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    y += 8
    tkw_label = "KEY TAKEAWAYS"
    tkf = font(INTER_BOLD, 13)
    draw.text((MARGIN, y), tkw_label, fill=AMBER, font=tkf)
    y += 28

    takeaways = [
        ("Agent-first development is surging",
         "hermes-agent's ~10K weekly stars dwarf every other entry", GREEN),
        ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast",
         "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product", PURPLE),
        ("Infrastructure tools show staying power",
         "markitdown's steady climb reflects sustained community interest", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ]

    ta_title_f = font(INTER_BOLD, 16)
    ta_text_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 14)

    for title_text, desc, color in takeaways:
        draw.ellipse((MARGIN + 4, y + 6, MARGIN + 14, y + 16), fill=color)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y), title_text, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=ta_title_f)
        draw.text((MARGIN + 24, y + 22), desc, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=ta_text_f)
        y += 52

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════
    # FOOTER
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════

    # Gradient fade at bottom
    for gy in range(40):
        alpha = gy / 40.0
        c = blend_color(BG, BG, alpha)
        draw.rectangle((0, H - 60 + gy, W, H - 60 + gy + 1), fill=c)

    footer_f = font(INTER_REGULAR, 12)
    footer_text = "Data sourced from star-history.com  \u2022  Week of April 9\u201315, 2026"
    fbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), footer_text, font=footer_f)
    fw = fbox[2] - fbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - fw) // 2, H - 36), footer_text, fill=TEXT_DIM, font=footer_f)

    return img


if __name__ == "__main__":
    img = create_poster()
    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
    print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px")

This looks excellent. Let me do a final visual assessment against the design brief criteria:

**Critical checks:**
1. **Content accuracy** — All 20 repos match source data, star counts correct, metrics match task_input.json (10 repos 2K+)
2. **Text readability** — All text clear and legible on dark background
3. **No clipping** — All content fits within frame, footer visible
4. **Visual hierarchy** — Title → stats → highlight → table → clusters → takeaways

**Design brief compliance:**
- Dark mode with charcoal background and vibrant accents
- Full Top 20 ranking table as centerpiece (largest section)
- 4 headline metrics prominently displayed
- Color-coded category tags (AGENT, CLAUDE, UTILITY, DESIGN, NEW)
- Star bars provide at-a-glance comparison
- #1 row highlighted with green glow
- Monospace font for numbers, geometric sans-serif (Inter) for text
- GitHub dark aesthetic

One final detail — the "REPOS 2K+" value should actually be 9 based on the source data (repos #1-9 all have 2K+ stars; #10 has 1,978). Let me recheck... The `task_input.json` says "10" with context "Half the leaderboard crossed the 2,000-star weekly threshold" — I'll keep it as specified in the task input since that's the authoritative requirement.
